description: AMI output-quality grading scale. `agent_output_grade` must be one of the grade codes below, and the API rejects anything else rather than storing it. `numeric_value` IS the Agent Quality score - it is used directly, with no second lookup table between the grade and the score, because a translation step between two scales is exactly where a grade silently changes meaning. Replace this file with your organisation's agreed scale if it differs, but keep that property.

grades.label: Usable as-is
grades.definition: Output meets every stated requirement of the workflow and is usable with no human edit.

grades.label: Minor edits needed
grades.definition: Output meets the substantive requirements; a human would make cosmetic or small factual corrections before use.

grades.label: Material rework needed
grades.definition: Output is directionally correct but a human must materially rework part of it before use.

grades.label: Mostly redone
grades.definition: Output misses or misinterprets requirements; most of the work would be redone by a human.

grades.label: No usable value
grades.definition: Output is wrong, incomplete to the point of no value, or was not produced.

grades.label: Not graded
grades.definition: No grade was assigned. Use only when the workflow produced no reviewable output or grading was deliberately deferred to a human reviewer. Agent Quality is unavailable for the run, and so is any score derived from it.
